records.body: Extremely positive! The team has been super resourceful, responsive, professional and knowledgeable. This tool is one of the easiest for us to use in our bonus and merit planning cycles.
records.pros: The system is incredibly easy to configure and intuitive for users - both HR admins and managers. The customer support and response time for our questions is phenomenal as well! Highly recommend.
records.cons: Our bonus planning system is complex, and it couldn't do everything, but it came really close and improved every single year. Alternatives considered [UKG Pro](https://www.capterra.com/p/480/UKG-Pro/) Reason for choosing SimplyMerit Configurability, customer support/responsiveness and pricing.
records.industry: Thank you, Steve! We recently rolled out significant advancements in customization options and will schedule time with you to share as well as solicit additional feedback.

records.review_title: Moz Local is a MUST for any small business owner
records.body: I've had a great experience with Moz Local over the past 4 years. Nothing negative to say, their syndication and reporting and noting of duplicates is great and a must have for any small business owner.
records.pros: This is insanely easy to setup and use and the reporting and information it provides a small business owner is great. I work with clients that range from 200+ locations down to 1 location and this software is perfect for small business owners. The reporting is quick and easy and clients love being able to login and see most everything in 2-3 clicks.
records.cons: I wish they could automate some of their process for bigger clients, but the reason they are so cost friendly is because you have to do "some" manual work to clean up duplicates. Alternatives considered [Yext](https://www.capterra.com/p/140176/Yext/) Reason for choosing Moz Pro Moz is a more cost efficient product and provides more for small business owners than Yext does.

records.review_title: Kontentino is exactly the tool, we were looking for...
records.pros: It is well-arranged, easy to use, you can plan ahead, make comments and approve (or not) posts. We also love automated publishing and the analytics and reporting.
records.cons: The only thing, that we struggled with, were the expenses - we have quite a big team with every member the costs get higher. But then we found out that it\`s worth it.
records.reviewer_name: User-friendly interface: Intuitive and easy to navigate, even for beginners. Efficient collaboration tools: Streamlined workflow for team communication, approvals, and comments, reducing the need for back-and-forth emails. Post previews: Visual previews for each social media platform ensure optimal formatting. Organized content calendar: Clear scheduling and tracking of posts across platforms. Client approval process: Simplifies client approvals with an easy-to-use interface.
records.industry: Client approval process: It's a great process, but when a post gets disapproved, the client has to approve again, before you can post it.

records.review_title: Monday.com - Review as Manager and User
records.body: Very nice and easy so far. I like how simple and easy to navigate it is. It grows with practice though.
